extension.summary: The time in words on a grid of letters, like a QlockTwo-style word clock
extension.description: A word clock: an 11 by 11 grid of letters where the words that tell the time light up, such as IT IS FIVE TO TWO PM or IT IS TEN PAST MIDNIGHT. It looks like the classic graphite word clock by default. In the settings you can change the font (eight to choose from, from Inter to dot matrix and stencil), the colours with eight palettes or your own, separate day and night colours that switch by the clock, a glow, rainbow words, the frame and size, fade or ripple transitions, minute dots, rounding, dimming at night and a slow drift that protects OLED screens.
extension.disclaimer: Letters rendered from fonts under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LICENSE.txt.
